about: BLOOM-032B1 production plant sprite contract — the COMPLETE locked Organic Hybrid mutation vocabulary. The fixed rules every plant art pack (art/plant/packs/<pack>/atlas.png + atlas.json) is validated against by tools/build-plant-art.mjs. Human-readable version: docs/PLANT_SPRITE_PIPELINE_v1.md section ARTIST_HANDOFF. Changing this file is an ENGINE change (selector + QA), not an art change.

canvas.note: 84×98 is the PMO-APPROVED production target. One canonical logical plant canvas: every placement (Adapt, Spread, Region Inspect, Field Journal) shows this exact buffer, scaled by a whole number with nearest-neighbour and padded; anatomy is never re-laid-out per UI. The maximal legal dry and wet organisms are proven to fit with a 1-px safety margin.

pixel.format: PNG, 8-bit per channel; colour types RGBA (6), RGB (2), indexed (3, incl. tRNS) or grey (0 / 4); not interlaced
pixel.alpha: every pixel is fully transparent (alpha 0) or fully opaque (alpha 255); partial alpha is a build error
pixel.palette: every opaque pixel inside a sprite rect must be EXACTLY one of the pack's declared palette colours (atlas.json palette); arbitrary RGBA is a build error. A colour means a material + shade, so the renderer can recolour it (treatments, condition).
pixel.mask: a mask rect has the sprite's exact size; any opaque pixel (any colour) = inside the mask, transparent = outside
pixel.strays: no opaque pixel may lie outside every declared rect (sprite, mask, swatch)

materials.name: stem
materials.role: stem, petiole, stalks; also drawn procedurally by the renderer

materials.name: root
materials.role: roots; also drawn procedurally by the renderer

materials.name: salt
materials.role: salt glands, faceted crystals / deposits (NEVER frost colours: salt must not read as snow)

materials.name: pigLeaf
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: leaf under protective pigment (never drawn in a sprite)

materials.name: pigStem
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: stem under protective pigment

materials.name: pigCore
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: storage tissue under protective pigment

materials.name: waxLeaf
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: leaf under a reflective wax cuticle

materials.name: waxCore
materials.role: TREATMENT TARGET: storage tissue under a reflective wax cuticle

pigment.note: Radiation Shielding: protective red/violet pigment. Recolours masked pixels shade-for-shade; the procedural stem and branches take it too.

wax.note: Heat Tolerance: reflective wax cuticle. Level = heat tier: T1 recolours only the lit shades (2–3) — a sheen; T2 shades 1–3; T3 every shade. Applied to whichever leaf structure is active.

toothed.note: Salt Handling: tougher, toothed margins. Pixels inside the sprite's authored 'toothed' mask are CLEARED (notches cut into the margin). No mask = no teeth (for leaf forms where teeth are inappropriate).

orientations.right: faces / grows toward +x from its anchor; the build bakes the mirrored left twin when "mirror": true
orientations.left: an explicitly authored left-facing variant; overrides the baked mirror of the same id
orientations.up: upright and centred on its anchor; never mirrored
orientations.down: hangs below its anchor; never mirrored

angles.low: near horizontal (about 10° above horizontal): the lower stem nodes
angles.mid: about 40° above horizontal: the middle nodes
angles.high: about 65° above horizontal: the upper nodes and the compact / cushion rosettes

attach.leafSocket: a stem node's left / right leaf socket (the anchor = the petiole base, on the stem's edge)
attach.leafPoint: a point declared by the LEAF SPRITE itself — points.tip or one of points.margin; surface details ride on whichever leaf drawing is active (the selector chooses tip and/or margins)
attach.stemNode: centred on the stem at a node (wool collars)
attach.axil: the leaf axil: the stem's edge just above a node (closed vegetative axillary buds)
attach.rootCrown: where the stem meets the soil line
attach.primaryRoot: on the primary root just below the crown (storage tuber)
attach.aerialRoot: a point ON the soil line beside the crown where a breathing root rises (anchor = the root's bottom pixel, in the soil row)
attach.stiltRoot: the stem's edge a fixed height above the soil, where a stilt / snorkel root leaves the stem and arches down into the soil
attach.flower: the flower socket (the apex, or the flower branch's tip when a seed head holds the apex)
attach.seedHead: a seed-head socket (index 0 = the apex, 1 and 2 = side branches)
attach.pod: a pod socket: the tip of a low side stalk; the pod hangs below it
attach.drift: free points around the apex for drifting seeds

families.leaf: structural leaf drawings (one PRIMARY leaf structure at a time: neutral, Drought T1–T3 or Flood T1–T3; Heat T3 swaps in the structure's .heat variant)
families.root: structural root adaptations (storage tubers, breathing / aerial roots, stilt roots)
families.frost: COLD insulation only: fine hairs, wool collars. Never used for salt.
families.salt: SALT only: glands, faceted crystals / deposits. Never used for frost.
families.bud: closed vegetative buds (BASE: never an open flower)
families.seedHead: dry seed / dispersal heads and drifting seeds (Seed Output only)
families.pod: buoyant waterborne pods / fruit (Waterborne Seeds only)

visualCap.note: Gameplay water-arm tiers are mechanically uncapped; every tier ≥ 3 draws as the authored T3 anatomy. No T4+ asset exists or is ever requested.
